classifier.title: Email classifier
classifier.description: Picks the category badge ("Newsletter", "Bill", ...) on each incoming mail. Heuristic is instant and offline; LLM uses your local Yorik LLM for sharper tagging.
classifier.heuristicHint: Regex rules. ~1 ms per mail. Reliable but coarse.
classifier.llmHint: Local Qwen via HOMEOS_LLM_BASE_URL. ~1–2 s per mail. Sharper categories.
classifier.reclassifyHint: Reclassify existing mail with the current setting.
classifier.readBillsHint: The local LLM picks amount and due date for "New bill?" — the total, not the subtotal, in any language and notation. An amount that isn't in the mail is ignored. Off: rules only.

steps: Open Google's app passwords page (sign in if asked).
Type "Yorik" as the name and tap Create.
Copy the 16 letters Google shows and paste them below.
Open your Apple account page and sign in.
Go to Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords.
Create one called "Yorik" and paste it below.
Only if you use two-step sign-in: open Microsoft's security page.
Advanced security options → App passwords → Create.
Paste it below. Without two-step sign-in, your normal password works.
